stories.headline: Nabers Dodges the Sick Wagon, and the Whole Saloon Just Got Nervous
stories.read: The Giants declined to park Malik Nabers on the laid-up list to start camp, and the fella's out there rippin' routes at full speed ten months off a busted knee. No return date yet, but folks who've watched him say Week 1 against Dallas is a real possibility, not a prayer. Here's the read, pardner: outfits do not leave a man off that list unless they mean to play him. Half your outfit still has him marked down as damaged goods and slides him a full round or two past where he belongs. That's the whole trade right there. Let 'em flinch, then take the best cut of throws in New York for pennies on the dollar.

stories.headline: Tucker Kraft Walks Out of the Infirmary, and the Cheapest Big Man in the Territory Just Got Cheaper
stories.read: Green Bay sprung Kraft off the laid-up list Friday, eight and a half months after he shredded a knee back in November. LaFleur's easin' him in slow, individual drills and evenin' walkthroughs only, no full contact 'til they hit that nine-month mark. Now think it through: before he went down he was the best pass-catchin' big man on that ranch and Love's favorite target when things got close to paydirt. The saloon's got him buried behind four or five safer names because they saw the word knee and stopped readin'. Doc says let 'em. You get an every-week starter at a bench-warmer price, and that vein pays all season.

stories.headline: Baker Mayfield Slams the Ledger Shut in Tampa and Rides Off Angry
stories.read: Mayfield set himself a deadline of camp openin' to get paid, camp opened, no deal came, and now he says he's done talkin' money 'til the season's over. Says he feels disrespected. Bowles claims it ain't a distraction. Doc has watched this exact hand get dealt before, pardner, and here's how it plays: a proud gunslinger playin' for his next contract with nothin' guaranteed past this year throws the ball like a man on fire. That's good news for every hand catchin' passes in that wagon, and it makes Mayfield himself cheap gold at the back end of the signal-caller pile. Let the nervous fellas fret about locker-room drama. You just take the volume.
